text:
Ellen (Partnerships): Heads-up: EdgeNodes (hardware marketplace partner) reported invoice variance after switching to our new hourly rollup. They say some hourly buckets were missing causing under-reporting. Need quick root-cause + partner-facing explanation.
Omar (Partner Eng): they replaced their agent and increased parallelism; their agent publishes with clock skew ~30s which put events on the wrong hour boundary in our ingest window.
Victor (Eng-Platform): we window by UTC hour aligned boundaries and use event_timestamp; small skews shouldn't drop buckets though. possible issue: our late-arrival pipeline prunes events older than 2h without tombstone handling. if agent replays tombstones after prune, negative deltas can occur.
Faye (Billing): for the partner, negative deltas mean credits. We need deterministic reconciliation: steps to verify and timeframe to accept claims.
Sam (Revenue Ops): propose: 1) 45-day claim window from invoice date, 2) auto-smoothing for net < $200 per account, 3) full audit for larger claims. Also need to know how often this can be used to prevent abuse.
Omar (Partner Eng): EdgeNodes requests a signed "replay_manifest" whenever they do a replay so they can correlate which hourly buckets changed. Can we emit that?
Victor (Eng-Platform): yes. We'll emit a replay_manifest for each replay job with fields (replay_id, partner_id, affected_buckets[], before_hash, after_hash). Example bundle generation cmd: 
```
POST /internal/replay
{ "partner":"edgenodes", "start":"2026-03-01T00:00Z", "end":"2026-03-01T03:00Z" }
// response -> {"replay_id":"r_abc123", "manifest_url":"https://s3/.../r_abc123.json"}
```
Ellen (Partnerships): include a human-friendly summary and a CSV per-customer delta in the manifest so EdgeNodes finance can reconcile quickly.
Faye (Billing): require the manifest to include signed checksum (sha256) and the operator who triggered it. Also we need to limit replay-permissions to partners that have replay_rights=true in contract.
Sam (Revenue Ops): commercial note: if partner-triggered replay results in credits, decide who pays compute/storage for replay. Suggest: partner covers replay cost unless we detect an ingestion bug on our side.
Victor (Eng-Platform): agree. We'll tag replay bundles with cost_code and include estimated compute_cost in manifest. ops-bot: "policy: replay_cost -> partner_unless_platform_bug"
Omar (Partner Eng): EdgeNodes also asked for a real-time 'bucket-ack' webhook so they can mark buckets as settled before invoice close. Could be a simple POST per hour with high_watermark.
Victor (Eng-Platform): doable. We'll add partner bucket-ack endpoint with HMAC signature and idempotency-key support. Example header usage: 
```
X-Partner-Signature: sha256=abcd
Idempotency-Key: edgenodes-20260301-00
```
Faye (Billing): bucket-ack is useful: if partner acknowledges the hour, any later negative deltas must be supported by a replay manifest and will be treated as a dispute credit. Add to policy.
Ellen (Partnerships): action items: Victor -> PR for replay_manifest + bucket-ack endpoint; Faye -> draft credit/dispute policy and smoothing thresholds; Sam -> add replay_cost clause to partner playbook; Omar -> coordinate with EdgeNodes to run a staged replay in staging. Deadline Fri EOD?
Victor (Eng-Platform): PRs by Fri, include manifest schema and sample signed bundle generator.
Omar (Partner Eng): will schedule staged replay and send logs to eng-platform.
Sam (Revenue Ops): also add quota: max 2 partner-initiated replays per billing cycle without sales approval. Put it in draft.
Faye (Billing): will require that claims include partner_manifest + our internal replay bundle + CSV of their observed usage. We'll only issue credits after matching checksums.
Victor (Eng-Platform): technical note: change prune threshold to 7d for replayable raw events in premium retention tier. Default remains 48h for standard tiers. We'll surface retention_tier on partner profiles.
ops-bot: "task created: #PR-6201 (replay-manifest), #API-921 (bucket-ack-webhook), #POL-341 (replay-cost-and-credit-policy)"
Ellen (Partnerships): thanks all. Omar — please confirm EdgeNodes accepts the replay-cost rule; if not we escalate to sales.
Omar (Partner Eng): will confirm.
Victor (Eng-Platform): final: all replay bundles will include provenance for each changed record: {orig_ts, ingest_ts, source_agent, op_type}. This avoids ambiguity during reconciliation.
Faye (Billing): perfect. include a short sample reconciliation checklist for finance teams.
ops-bot: "thread closed: replay-manifest-and-bucket-ack-design"
